newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-TWO ITALIAN SERIE B PLAYERS DIE IN CAR CRASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO ITALIAN SERIE B PLAYERS DIE IN CAR CRASH.

text.p: Two soccer players from newly-promoted Italian Serie B club Castel di Sangro died in a motorway car crash on Tuesday, police said.

Striker Danilo Di Vincenzo, 28, and defender Filippo Biondi, 19, were killed when their car careered off the motorway near the central Italian town of Orvieto and hit a truck parked in a roadside lay-by.
Both men were squad members of a side whose presence in Italy's second division alongside big city clubs such as Torino is something of a miracle.
Castel di Sangro, nestling in a valley in the rugged central Abruzzi mountains, has just 5,600 residents and only inaugurated its new stadium earlier this month.
